According to the sources, the total initial mass in space for the 2033 crew flight is 127t, and the mass of the transit habitat is 36.6t [1]. To find the mass of the transit habitat itself, we need to subtract the mass of the transit habitat from the total initial mass in space.

Mass of transit habitat = 36.6t
Total initial mass in space = 127t

Mass not the transit habitat itself = Total initial mass in space - Mass of transit habitat
= 127t - 36.6t
= 90.4t

Therefore, 90.4t of the total initial mass in space is not the transit habitat itself.
